newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral sees US$47 mln gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral sees US$47 mln gain from sale.

text.p: Building products company Boral Ltd said on Friday it expected to earn a pre-tax abnormal profit of about US$47 million on the sale of its U.S.-based Briar Gypsum wallboard division to James Hardie Industries Ltd.
Boral said it sold the unit for US$97 million and had announced its plans to sell the operation in October last year.
The sale should be completed by the end of January 1997.
Briar has a manufacturing plant at Nashville, Arkansas, and had 1995/96 sales of US$81 million.

"We are pleased to have sold Briar Gypsum to another Australian company, which is already a participant in the U.S. wallboard industry, after a competitive bidding process. Boral has obtained a good price for a successful business," Boral managing director Tony Berg said.

"Despite Briar being a strong performer in recent years, we decided to sell because, consistent with our stated strategy, Briar did not have the potential on a stand-alone basis as a single plant to obtain a leading position in the U.S. wallboard market," Berg said.
